title: BART Live Map Telemetry & Consist Car Tracker Overhaul
summary: Enhanced the real-time BART Live Map with physical train car counts next to train icons, next-upcoming-station arrival and departure telemetry, labeled all 49 stations across the network, and multi-line color picker support.

changes.description: Replaced the generic indicator next to the train icon with the actual number of train cars on that consist (e.g. [8 Cars 🚆] and [10 Cars 🚆]), clearly displaying consist capacity on both the live map station labels and locomotive markers.

Calibrated Live Map Expected Arrival and Departure to explicitly represent the next upcoming station (when the train will arrive at and depart from the next stop), alongside a full stop-by-stop timetable for all upcoming stations on the train's route.
Rendered all 49 BART station names directly on the Live Map SVG with calibrated non-overlapping coordinates, transfer hub typography, and pulsing train presence halos.
Enabled multi-select line color filtering allowing users to pick any combination of transit lines simultaneously (Green, Yellow, Red, Orange, Blue) with active train counters per line.
Implemented adaptive multi-device layout with expanded desktop main workspace (max-w-7xl) and touch-optimized navigation drawer for mobile and Android Chrome.

title: BART Schedule Planner — Bay Area Rapid Transit Engine
summary: Launched the second core project under My Projects: a real-time route, departure, and live train tracker for the San Francisco Bay Area BART rail network, featuring origin-station departures and line-specific train position filtering.

changes.description: Added BART Schedule Planner as second sub-project in My Projects with dedicated route: /myprojects/bart.

Calibrated Milpitas-Embarcadero transit time to ~59 min (about 1 hr) and Clipper fare to $9.65 ($4.80 Youth, $3.60 Senior).
